definitions.gloss: packed in a box, boxed, box-packed
definitions.explanation: Items arranged and packed in a box, typically for sale as a gift set or for shipping. Also used as a modifier.

examples.japanese: ⟦クッキー→クッキー：10798_kukkii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{箱詰|はこづ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a box of cookies.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{中元|ちゅうげん}→お中元：06125_ochuugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{箱詰|はこづ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave a boxed set of fruit as a midyear gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{箱詰|はこづ}めにして⟦{発送|はっそう}する→発送する：21737_hassousuru⟧。
examples.english: We box up the products and ship them.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧ (box) + ⟦{詰|つ}め→詰む：27840_tsumu⟧ (packing/filling). Used for items packed neatly in a box, especially for gifts or commercial sale.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {箱詰|はこづ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to box up
- {箱詰|はこづ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧: boxed sweets
- {箱詰|はこづ}め⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: boxed product
- ⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{箱詰|はこづ}め: boxed fruit

SIMILAR PATTERN:
The ～{詰|づ}め pattern applies to other containers:
- {袋詰|ふくろづ}め: bagged
- {缶詰|かんづ}め: canned
- {瓶詰|びんづ}め: bottled

CULTURAL NOTE:
{箱詰|はこづ}め gifts are standard for ⟦お{中元|ちゅうげん}→お中元：06125_ochuugen⟧ (midyear gifts) and ⟦お{歳暮|せいぼ}→お歳暮：06126_oseibo⟧ (year-end gifts) in Japan.
